name: Prague
title: Prague in December
lead: Three days on foot around the centre. Markets are in the evening, the castle and viewpoints are by day, because the sun sets early.
facts: Sunrise around 7:50, sunset around 15:50. The best light is around 15:00. All times are Prague time, one hour behind Bulgarian time.
Usually between −2 and 3 °C. Bring warm shoes with a non-slip sole; the cobblestones are slippery.
Last season ran from 25 November to 6 January, with stalls open 10:00–22:00 and food until midnight. Check prague.eu for this year's dates.
On 24, 25 and 26 December many restaurants and sights have shorter hours. Check ahead.
Czech koruna (CZK). Some small places accept cash only.

days.title: Old Town and Josefov
days.theme: Start early from the square, have a Czech lunch and spend the evening at the market.

stops.name: Old Town Square
stops.d: Arrive before the crowds. The Orloj astronomical clock performs every hour. Walk around the square and see the Týn Church towers from outside.

stops.name: Coffee or breakfast on Valentinská
stops.d: Three places on one street, 3 minutes from the square.

stops.name: Josefov, the Jewish Quarter
stops.d: Pařížská street and the old synagogues from outside. The museums are paid and closed on Saturday.

stops.name: Lunch with Czech food
stops.d: Come before 12:00 or book; there is often a queue.

opts.s: Czech food on the way to the bridge

stops.name: Karlova street to Charles Bridge
stops.d: Take narrow Karlova around 14:00 and be on the bridge by 15:00, when the light is softest. Along the way there are stalls with trdelník, roasted chestnuts and hot drinks.

stops.name: Sunset from the bridge or the riverbank
stops.d: Stop on the Vltava bank with a view of the castle while the sky turns red.

stops.name: Christmas market on Old Town Square
stops.d: Mulled wine (svařák), sausage, potato pancakes, baked bread and trdelník. Keep a spot near the tree.
stops.q: Old Town Square Christmas market Prague

stops.name: Dinner
stops.d: The first two are on or next to the square, the third is across the bridge in Malá Strana.

opts.s: right on the square, Czech food
by the Malá Strana bridge tower

days.title: Prague Castle and Malá Strana
days.theme: Early climb to the castle, lunch below it, coffee by the river and a view from Petřín before sunset.

stops.name: Prague Castle
stops.d: Be at the second courtyard before 9:00. The grounds are free from 6 to 22, paid buildings are open from 9 to 16. A Circuit B ticket is from 250 CZK, Circuit A from 350 CZK, valid for two days. Tuesday and Wednesday are quietest.

stops.name: Walk down Nerudova street
stops.d: Steep and beautiful street with baroque houses. It leads straight to Malá Strana.

stops.name: Lunch on Nerudova and Malostranské náměstí
stops.d: Three places within 2 minutes of each other.

stops.name: Kampa and the John Lennon Wall
stops.d: A small island with a path by the water and the wall on Velkopřevorské square.

stops.name: Coffee by the river
stops.d: Three cafés in Malá Strana, all by the water or near Charles Bridge.

opts.s: breakfast and brunch by the river

opts.q: The Miners Coffee Charles Bridge Prague

stops.name: Petřín hill and tower
stops.d: The tower is open until 18:00 according to Google. The climb is steep and the funicular is sometimes closed, so check ahead. Arrive before sunset.

stops.name: Dinner in Malá Strana
stops.d: After coming down from Petřín, around Újezd and Malostranské náměstí.

days.title: New Town, Vyšehrad and the last market
days.theme: A calmer day. Wenceslas Square, the river, Vyšehrad fortress and the market again in the evening.

stops.name: Wenceslas Square
stops.d: The long boulevard with a market in season. Last season the stalls opened at 10:00, so come a bit later.

stops.name: Coffee or breakfast around Wenceslas Square
stops.d: Three places around the square.

opts.s: restaurant and café on the square

stops.name: Národní třída (National Avenue)
stops.d: Walk down Národní toward the Vltava. The street is full of theatres, bookshops and eateries.

stops.name: Lunch on Národní
stops.d: Three places on the same street.

stops.name: Dancing House and along the river to Vyšehrad
stops.d: From the Dancing House go up the right bank of the Vltava, about 25 minutes on foot to Vyšehrad.

stops.name: Vyšehrad
stops.d: The old fortress with ramparts, a park and the Vyšehrad cemetery. A quiet place after the centre.

stops.name: A warm drink at Vyšehrad
stops.d: Three places 3–10 minutes from the fortress.

opts.n: Plzeňská restaurace u Vyšehradu, Ostrčilovo nám. 4

stops.name: Sunset from the Vyšehrad walls
stops.d: A view down the Vltava toward the castle. An alternative sunset spot is Vyhlídka na Letné on the other bank, if you prefer a park.

stops.name: Last market
stops.d: Back to Old Town Square for mulled wine and last photos with the lit-up towers.
stops.q: Old Town Square Christmas market Prague

stops.name: Farewell dinner
stops.d: Three places 5–10 minutes' walk from Old Town Square.
